brief: Four sandstone Renaissance wings around an open courtyard; distinct Trumpeter, Cannon, Kings, lighthouse and Pigeon towers, copper roofs, domed stair turrets, ornate gables, north passage and mapped bastion edges.

nativeAxes.origin: Exact-Q189358 component frame;Y0 reconstructed courtyard floor.

reconstruction.basis: Attributed OSM coordinates; museum plan, aerial and courtyard photographs; CBS height description.
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Fresh exact-Q189358 relation1588209 and13 component ways agree with retained source vertices within1mm. Native+X5.043deg points north;+Z95.043deg points east. Mapped lighthouse node1400918158/Q20042645 fixes north-east corner,chapel fixes south-east and the flat Cannon tower lies south-west; signed entrance points north. ModelY0 is reconstructed courtyard floor,Trumpeter top59m above it. Site absolute datum is not claimed; CBS62m above water implies3m courtyard-to-water,not a survey. No land plinth,whole-precinct replacement,moat excavation or synthetic ground presented as measured Danish DHM.

Medium-fi exterior reconstruction: other tower and wall heights,window spacing,gable scrolls,roof junctions and stair turret profiles are proportional estimates. Royal figurative reliefs,inscriptions,clock faces and weathering patches are simplified.

Full crownwork,ravelins,coastal batteries,landscape,moat and interiors are supplied by other layers or omitted. No copied photos or individually modeled stone joints. Shared sandstone,copper,granite,brick,timber and painted-metal graphs plus opaque PBR glass.

Public national Danish DHM requires API-key access; no numeric DHM was retrieved. Relative courtyard contact and occupied foundations are reviewed; exact terrain slopes,absolute sea/vertical datum and every defensive wall ground fit remain unverified. Physical laptop/phone timings remain pending.
